name: Zenith Banking
description: Next-generation digital banking platform with real-time transactions and AI-driven insights.
full_description:
# Zenith Banking

Zenith Banking is a full-stack fintech platform designed for modern consumers who need complete visibility and control over their finances.

## The Problem

Existing banking apps were slow, cluttered, and gave users almost no intelligence about their own money. Zenith was built to change that.

## What Was Built

A production-grade banking dashboard built with **Next.js App Router** and **Supabase**, featuring:
- Real-time account balances with optimistic UI updates
- AI-powered spending categorization using OpenAI API
- Multi-currency support with live exchange rates via Frankfurter API
- End-to-end Stripe payment integration (deposits, transfers, payouts)
- WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility compliance

## Technical Highlights

```typescript
// Real-time transaction subscription
const channel = supabase
  .channel('transactions')
  .on('postgres_changes', { event: 'INSERT', schema: 'public', table: 'transactions' }, 
    (payload) => updateBalance(payload.new)
  )
  .subscribe()
```

## Results

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Users Onboarded | 12,000+ |
| Transactions/Day | 50,000 |
| Uptime | 99.97% |
| Avg Response Time | 180ms |
bullets: Real-time transaction processing with optimistic UI updates
AI spending categorization using OpenAI GPT-4
Multi-currency support with live exchange rates
End-to-end Stripe payment and payout integration
WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility compliant throughout

name: Nebula AI Platform
description: AI-powered content generation SaaS — text, images, and code in one unified workspace.
full_description:
# Nebula AI Platform

Nebula is a multi-modal AI SaaS application enabling creators, marketers, and developers to generate high-quality content at scale.

## The Problem

Teams were juggling 4–5 separate AI tools. Nebula unified them into one seamless workspace with shared context, billing, and collaboration.

## What Was Built

Powered by **GPT-4** and **Stable Diffusion**, Nebula provides:
- Unified workspace for text, image, and code generation
- Team collaboration with real-time co-editing
- Version history and prompt library
- Usage analytics dashboard
- Stripe subscription and credit-based billing

## Architecture

```
Frontend (Next.js) → API Routes → OpenAI / Stability AI
                  ↓
           PostgreSQL (usage tracking)
                  ↓
           Stripe (billing & credits)
```

## Results

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Prompts Processed | 2M+ |
| Active Teams | 800 |
| Avg AI Response | 1.2s |
| MRR | $28,000 |
bullets: Multi-modal AI: text, images, and code generation in one workspace
Team workspaces with role-based access control
Real-time collaboration and version history
Usage analytics dashboard for admins and team leads
Stripe subscription and credit billing system

name: Aether Social
description: Decentralized social network with on-chain identity and direct creator monetization.
full_description:
# Aether Social

Aether Social is a Web3-native social platform giving users full ownership of their identity and content via Ethereum smart contracts.

## The Problem

Centralized platforms collect and monetize user data. Aether flips the model — users own their content, creators get paid directly, and no algorithm decides what you see.

## What Was Built

- On-chain identity via ENS and user-controlled wallets
- Token-gated posts — creators set minimum token balance for access
- Direct crypto tips (ETH and ERC-20 tokens)
- Content stored on IPFS — censorship resistant
- Cross-platform: iOS, Android, and Web PWA

## Smart Contract Architecture

```solidity
contract AetherProfile {
    mapping(address => Profile) public profiles;
    mapping(address => Post[]) public posts;
    
    function createPost(string memory _ipfsHash, uint256 _minTokens) 
        external returns (uint256 postId) {
        // posts stored on-chain, content on IPFS
    }
}
```

## Results

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Monthly Active Users | 28,000 |
| Posts Created | 140,000+ |
| Creator Revenue | $180,000 |
| Chain Transactions | 320,000 |
bullets: On-chain identity via ENS and user-controlled wallets
Token-gated posts with creator-set access conditions
Decentralized content storage on IPFS
Direct crypto tips — ETH and ERC-20 token support
Cross-platform: native iOS, Android, and web PWA

name: Catalyst CRM
description: Lightweight CRM for growing agencies — pipelines, contacts, and automated follow-up sequences.
full_description:
# Catalyst CRM

Catalyst is a modern sales pipeline and customer relationship tool designed for small-to-mid agencies who find tools like Salesforce overwhelming and Notion too manual.

## The Problem

Most CRMs are built for enterprises. Agencies need something fast, visual, and connected to their email. Catalyst delivers exactly that.

## What Was Built

- Drag-and-drop Kanban sales pipelines
- Automated follow-up email sequences via Resend
- Client health score based on activity and engagement signals
- Real-time board updates with Supabase Realtime subscriptions
- CSV import/export for bulk contact management

## Sequence Automation

```typescript
// Automated follow-up after deal moves to 'Proposal Sent'
const onDealMoved = async (deal: Deal, newStage: Stage) => {
  if (newStage.name === 'Proposal Sent') {
    await scheduleSequence(deal.contactEmail, 'proposal-followup', {
      delayDays: [3, 7, 14]
    })
  }
}
```

## Results

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Agencies Using | 120+ |
| Deals Closed | 3,200 |
| Emails Sent | 890,000 |
| Avg Deal Time Saved | 4.2 hrs/wk |
bullets: Drag-and-drop Kanban pipeline with real-time board sync
Automated email follow-up sequences via Resend
Client health score based on activity signals
CSV import/export for bulk contact management
Role-based access — account managers see only their clients

name: Momentum Fitness
description: AI-powered personal trainer app that adapts workouts to your real performance and goals.
full_description:
# Momentum Fitness

Momentum is a cross-platform fitness application that uses on-device machine learning to create personalized workout plans that actually adapt over time.

## The Problem

Most fitness apps give you a static plan. Real fitness requires adaptation — adjusting intensity, rest periods, and exercises based on your actual performance. Momentum does this automatically.

## What Was Built

- On-device AI personalization using TensorFlow Lite
- Apple Health and Google Fit biometric sync
- Gamified streak and achievement system
- Video exercise demonstrations with rep counting
- Social challenges and friend leaderboards

## ML Pipeline

```python
# Adaptive training model
class WorkoutAdaptationModel:
    def predict_next_session(self, user_history: UserHistory) -> WorkoutPlan:
        fatigue_score = self.calculate_fatigue(user_history.recent_sessions)
        readiness = self.hrv_analysis(user_history.biometrics)
        return self.generate_plan(fatigue_score, readiness, user_history.goals)
```

## Results

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| App Downloads | 45,000 |
| Workouts Logged | 320,000 |
| App Store Rating | 4.8 ★ |
| Day-30 Retention | +22% vs static plans |
bullets: On-device AI workout personalization with TensorFlow Lite
Apple Health and Google Fit biometric data sync
Gamified streak and achievement system
Video exercise demos with rep counting via camera
Social challenges and friend leaderboards
